attestations.text: CHAO Chih-ch'ien 趙之謙 (T. 益甫, 撝叔, H. 悲盦, 梅庵, 旡悶, 憨寮, 冷君, 思悲翁), 1829–1884, Nov.–Dec., scholar and bibliophile who was also skilled in calligraphy, painting and seal-carving, was a native of K'uai-chi, Chekiang.
